name: KRONO
recent: Kronologi Asia Berhad 近期发布了截至2026年7月31日的季度财报，营收环比微增0.2%，但净利润同比下滑25.9%。公司近期有多项「OTHERS」类公告，但未披露具体内容，新闻方面无直接相关报道。
risks: 净利润同比下滑25.9%，尽管营收同比增长4.8%。
净利率仅1.8%，盈利水平较低。
earnings: 截至2026年7月31日的季度，营收为MYR 62.07百万，环比增长0.2%，同比增长4.8%；净利润为MYR 1.12百万，环比增长11.4%，但同比下降25.9%；净利率为1.8%，高于上一季度的1.6%。

recent_en: Kronologi Asia Berhad recently released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026, with revenue up 0.2% QoQ but net income down 25.9% YoY. The company has several 'OTHERS' announcements with no disclosed details, and no directly related news coverage.
risks_en: Net income declined 25.9% YoY despite revenue growing 4.8% YoY.
Net margin is only 1.8%, indicating low profitability.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 62.07 million, up 0.2% QoQ and 4.8% YoY; net income was MYR 1.12 million, up 11.4% QoQ but down 25.9% YoY; net margin was 1.8%, higher than 1.6% in the previous quarter.
